Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR adds Canvas and Memory Core migration sources and destinations to newly created recovery copies. **Example:** Doctor migrates /srv/canvas/documents/retained/index.html into core Canvas storage. - **Before:** The recovery copy omits the original document and the initially absent destination. - **After:** The recovery copy preserves the original document and records the destination's prior absence. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | A focused, useful repair with meaningful capture-boundary coverage and no remaining code finding; shipped upgrade validation is still outstanding. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Ordinary contributor proof is exempt for this maintainer-authored PR; supplied tests exercise production capture and read-only collection, but the separate repository-required published-updater × candidate validation remains unverified. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Doctor can move or remove legacy plugin files that its recovery copy did not preserve. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored scope repairs newly created recovery copies and explicitly preserves the limitation of older installed updaters. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR repairs a current recovery-inventory defect, and the prior rollback-journal finding is fixed; no new actionable code defect was found. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The required v2026.10.1 published-updater × candidate scenario has not been supplied, including preserved settings and data, retained older captures, and the declared legacy resources.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Plugin collectors translate configuration and legacy file locations into resource declarations consumed by Doctor's existing recovery capture owner before migrations run. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Configuration and legacy files] --> B[Plugin migration collectors] B --> C[Doctor resource preparation] C --> D[Recovery capture owner] D --> E[Payloads and recovery manifest] E --> F[Existing state migrations] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Complete the plugin-owned inventories through the existing capture owner while preserving older recovery copies and migration behavior. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source shows migrations moving or deleting files without declaring their capture resources; the PR reports matching failing-before regressions, and this read-only review ran no target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Adding read-only declarations to the existing migration owners addresses the omission directly and reuses their source, archive, and companion contracts. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [a22eb8a59bf1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a22eb8a59bf128028182918d1c67df12eefe955c). ### Provenance checked - `Read-only migration resource declarations` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156326: Inspect declared plugin data before rehearsal while retaining strict path validation and undeclared-owner warnings.) - `Canvas document migration` keeps the original intent (9710a1339e3ca63ccc51ee79d2dd0c8c00917726: Move inline-widget hosting into core while migrating custom-root documents without changing their user-facing contract.) - `Retained Memory Core migrations` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113542: Split supported retained migrations into focused modules while preserving repair behavior; this establishes the refactor, not each migration's original introduction.) - `Rehearsal capture exclusions` keeps the original intent (d417b5202305f4f796e8e62586dfd05d57e1b242: Avoid duplicate disposable core database backups while retaining distinct plugin and configuration resources.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current-main defect remains:** The three production migration modules are unchanged between the introduction base and fetched main; they lack the collectors added by this PR. ([`extensions/canvas/doctor-contract-api.ts:39`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a22eb8a59bf128028182918d1c67df12eefe955c/extensions/canvas/doctor-contract-api.ts#L39), [a22eb8a59bf1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a22eb8a59bf128028182918d1c67df12eefe955c)) - **Prior finding resolved:** Both retry destination families now enumerate LEGACY_MEMORY_SIDECAR_SUFFIXES, including -journal, and the inventory regression checks both journal destinations. ([`extensions/memory-core/src/migration/doctor-memory-sidecar.ts:513`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2/extensions/memory-core/src/migration/doctor-memory-sidecar.ts#L513), [6f74615ca1f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2)) - **Capture-boundary coverage:** The extended test uses production capture and manifest owners to check original Canvas bytes and an absent destination; registry discovery is replaced with a fixture, and the PR reports failing-before and passing-after results. ([`src/commands/doctor-rehearsal-capture.test.ts:173`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2/src/commands/doctor-rehearsal-capture.test.ts#L173), [6f74615ca1f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2)) - **Existing declaration contract preserved:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156326 established read-only migration inventories and strict resource validation, crediting Peter Steinberger's original recovery work; this PR supplies inventories through that contract. ([`src/plugins/doctor-migration-resources.ts:28`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/4c468412dfef638a179fa1d82e5a6ea1b1d2be4d/src/plugins/doctor-migration-resources.ts#L28), [4c468412dfef](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4c468412dfef638a179fa1d82e5a6ea1b1d2be4d)) - **Verified no-migration case:** The introduced production hunks only add collectors; recovery manifests retain schema version 2, and admitted captures from older updaters are read and retained rather than rewritten. ([`src/infra/update-recovery-baseline-capture.ts:532`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2/src/infra/update-recovery-baseline-capture.ts#L532), [6f74615ca1f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2)) - **Required upgrade validation:** Root policy requires a published-driver × candidate cell for Doctor/update changes; the full PR body explicitly defers that validation and supplies no completed cell for this change. ([`AGENTS.md:80`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2/AGENTS.md#L80), [6f74615ca1f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f74615ca1f68b4aaf348410bf1c2e2c5287c7a2)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 5f482a7defc87b3c720a008efc215256af0a1fff adds extensions/memory-core/src/migration/doctor-memory-sidecar.ts:18 relative to its recorded parents. Label justifications: - `P2`: This focused repair protects recovery coverage for retained legacy Canvas and Memory Core files. - `rating: 🦐 gold shrimp`: Overall readiness is 🦐 gold shrimp; proof is 🦐 gold shrimp and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Link the scoped published-updater × candidate validation from the release campaign before landing. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab.
